items.title: Colapinto starts 5 places back
items.summary: Stewards gave Colapinto a 5-place grid drop for causing a collision in Baku. The model applies it to the qualifying order.

items.title: Mercedes bring another W17 upgrade
items.summary: The fastest car of 2026 gets a further update for Sepang.

items.title: McLaren: circuit-specific bodywork only
items.summary: After a big package in Azerbaijan, McLaren bring smaller, Sepang-specific parts. Baku was a pointless weekend for them, down on straight-line speed.

items.title: Verstappen expects an engine penalty soon
items.summary: He says a power unit penalty is coming, but no race is confirmed yet. Not applied until the stewards confirm it.

items.title: Rain is likely, especially Sunday
items.summary: Forecasts give up to a 90% chance of rain on race day and a 33°C high on Saturday. The model has no weather input, so a wet race makes it less reliable.

items.title: First F1 race at Sepang since 2017
items.summary: The Bahrain GP moved to Malaysia after the April race was cancelled. No driver has Sepang history in this dataset, so the circuit-record feature is neutral.

items.title: Baku: Russell beats Verstappen by 0.1s
items.summary: Russell led from lights to flag. Hadjar made it a Red Bull double podium; six drivers retired, including Norris.
